stories.summary: Start a test run from the command line with a Cognito token from SKILL_BUILDER_TOKEN, the same membership and run-start contract as the web form, and one runs row
Run the static-only security scan from the command line, record one static scans row with its findings, create no run, and exit 0 on PASS, 1 on FAIL or 2 when refused
Run the full static-then-LLM security scan from the command line using the project's configured LLM-scan model, record both scans rows, create no run, and exit as the scan's contract requires
Save a named project-scoped suite whose entries name a skill, input branch, context and expected final verdict, stored in suites.definition with the run's model profile and tier
Run a saved suite, create one run per resolvable entry, grade each entry against its expected final verdict, and record matched, mismatched, skipped and failed outcomes on the suite run
Enable or disable a saved suite's nightly schedule and have the 02:00 UTC tick create exactly one scheduled suite run per enabled suite per date
Record every scheduled suite run's date, state, counts and each entry's outcome with its reason, including skipped entries and failed executions, and keep the results across dates
